title: [SMS] ShowMySkin!
description: A customizable 3D webcam of your own character on the HUD, inspired by Bedrock's paper doll. Client-side, never changes skins.
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94f5d556cb42640f9038d6c1d4efa5555b4ac28f.png)

> # ShowMySkin!
> A client-side Fabric mod that adds a small, customizable 3D *webcam* of your
> own character to your HUD — inspired by Bedrock Edition's paper doll.

---

---

## 🏮 About

**ShowMySkin!** shows your current look...

![ShowMySkin in action](https://i.imgur.com/cuJ5i7u.gif)

---

## 💎 Features

**Feature rich**
- 🎥 Live 3D preview of your own character on the HUD
- 🪟 Live preview inside the settings screen — every change shows instantly
- 🖱️ Drag-and-drop HUD editor — move, resize (drag the corner), hold Shift to snap
- 🏷️ Nameplate — your name or custom text above/below the window

**Highly customizable**
- 👁️ Visibility triggers — Always, Bedrock-like (only while moving), or only while
  sprinting / sneaking / swimming / elytra-flying / riding / holding a key
- 🧍 Preview pose — **Upright** (clean webcam look) or **Real** (your actual pose),
  with optional **keep-in-frame** so swimming/crawling stays centered
- 🎛️ Full camera control — angle, pitch, zoom, scale, offset; head can face the camera
- 🎞️ Animations — Real, Idle, Walk, Sprint, Freeze, plus turntable auto-rotate
- 🎨 Presets — Webcam Dark, Minimal Doll, Portrait, Full Body, Bedrock Classic

**Convenient**
- 🌍 Languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian
- 🧩 Optional Mod Menu integration
- ⌨️ Every keybind unbound by default (no conflicts)

---

## 🔧 How to open the settings

> Mod Menu → **ShowMySkin!** → Configure
> *or* bind a key under **Options → Controls → Key Binds → ShowMySkin!**

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility

| Minecraft | Loader | Environment |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| 1.21.8    | Fabric | Client-side |

ShowMySkin! draws your real player entity through the vanilla render pipeline, so
custom models (Figura, CPM) and emotes (Emotecraft) can appear automatically. This is
**best-effort** — per-custom-part control isn't guaranteed, and the mod always falls
back gracefully without crashing.

---

## ⚠️ Known limitations

- Per-body-part / armor hiding isn't implemented yet
- Animation-pack support (e.g. FreshMoves) is best-effort — use **Real** pose for the
  most compatible result
- Figura / CPM support is best-effort

---

*This is a beta. Some advanced options are planned. Bug reports and feedback welcome!*
